scripts.build: npm run build:sync && npm run build -w @hazcom/windows && npm run build -w @hazcom/mobile
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:sqlite && npm run test:sync
scripts.firebase:deploy: cd firebase && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --project hazcom-navigator-dev
scripts.test:firebase: npx -y firebase-tools@latest emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage --project demo-hazcom-navigator --config firebase/firebase.json "npm run test -w @hazcom/firebase-functions"
scripts.build:sync: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @hazcom/sync
scripts.test:sync: npm run build:sync && npm run test -w @hazcom/sync
scripts.test:sync:emulator: npm run build:sync && npm run build -w @hazcom/firebase-functions && npx -y firebase-tools@latest emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage,functions --project demo-hazcom-navigator --config firebase/firebase.json "node --test packages/sync/test/emulator.test.mjs"
scripts.test:scale: npm run build:sync && npm run build -w @hazcom/firebase-functions && npx -y firebase-tools@latest emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage,functions --project demo-hazcom-navigator --config firebase/firebase.json "node --test packages/sync/test/scalable.test.mjs"
